name: music_effects_rcon
description: Sound check: verify RCON fx commands — set, status, reset, hot-swap effects
script: announce RCON EFFECTS COMMANDS — SOUND CHECKS
strudel [c4 e4 g4 c5]*2 cps=0.5 lpf=800
announce 2/6: strudel fx command — add reverb to running pattern
announce 2/6: reverb should now be audible
announce 3/6: Hot-swap — change effects on a running pattern
announce 3/6: changing to hpf=800 (should get thin)
announce 4/6: FX off — effects should disappear
strudel [c4 e4 g4 c5]*2 cps=0.5 lpf=400 room=0.6
announce 4/6: resetting... sound should return to clean
announce 5/6: Stop resets — apply effects, stop, restart clean
strudel [c4 e4 g4 c5]*2 cps=0.5 room=0.8 delay=0.5
announce 5/6: restarting — should be clean (no reverb/delay)
announce 6/6: All effects at once — lpf+hpf+room+delay+distort+pan
strudel [c3 e3 g3 c4]*2 cps=0.5 lpf=1200 hpf=200 room=0.4 delay=0.3 distort=0.2 pan=0.6
notify {SCRIPT} "Did RCON fx set/reset/hot-swap work correctly?" ["All good","Issues","Broken"] {inspect} blocking
